_description: Response body returned by POST /api/model/train — summarises the completed training run including corpus statistics, evaluation metrics, and persistence status.

_notes.samplesUsed: Total labelled samples across both training and hold-out sets. The model is trained on 80% of these; 20% are held back for evaluation.
_notes.accuracyScore: Fraction of hold-out examples the model labelled correctly. Between 0.0 and 1.0.
_notes.precisionScore: Macro-averaged precision across POSITIVE and NEGATIVE classes on the hold-out set.
_notes.recallScore: Macro-averaged recall across POSITIVE and NEGATIVE classes on the hold-out set.
_notes.modelSavedToDisk: False if the model file could not be written (e.g. disk full, permission error). The model is still available in memory for classification in the current session.
_notes.note: Echoes back the note from the original TrainingRequest, if one was supplied.

_variant_successful_with_good_metrics._comment: A healthy training run on a well-balanced corpus of 165 samples.
_variant_successful_with_good_metrics.note: Manual retrain after bulk seed data import.

_variant_force_retrain_small_dataset._comment: Force retrain on a very small dataset — metrics are lower and less reliable.
_variant_force_retrain_small_dataset.note: Force retrain for development testing with limited seed data.

_variant_disk_save_failed._comment: Training succeeded but the model could not be saved to disk. Model is available in memory only.

note: Manual retrain after bulk seed data import.
